title: Handling Errors in FastAPI
learning_objectives: Raise HTTPException with a status code, detail and headers
Turn domain exceptions into responses with exception handlers
Build apps with a factory so every test starts from fresh state
hints: `if item_id not in stock: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found", headers={"X-Error": "missing"})`.
Declare `qty: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1)] = 1`; raise `OutOfStock(name, qty, available)` when `qty > available`.
`@app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)` with `fields = [".".join(str(p) for p in e["loc"]) for e in exc.errors()]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Raise HTTPException(404, detail=..., headers={"X-Error": "missing"}) for unknown ids.
Subtract qty from the stored stock and default qty to 1.
Raise OutOfStock before changing stock and map it to 409 in an exception handler.
Register a RequestValidationError handler that joins each loc with '.'.
Create the stock dict inside create_app, not at module level.
